title: Hospital sample robot
subtitle: Autonomous transport of clinical samples
deck: Moving samples between hospital departments without breaking the chain of custody.
role: Vehicle architecture, CAD of the chassis and lockable compartments, and final renders.

sections.title: Context and brief
paragraphs: Clinical samples travel many times a day between wards and laboratories, and every handover is a risk for traceability.

sections.title: Approach
paragraphs: Vehicle architecture, lockable compartments for samples and navigation through hospital corridors, with LiDAR and differential drive.
